description: This file defines an abstract class Command within the namespace OrangeHRM\Framework\Console. The class extends Symfony's Command class and provides additional methods for handling Input and Output interfaces, specifically setting up a SymfonyStyle object for enhanced console interactions. It also declares an abstract method getCommandName() that subclasses must implement to specify the command's name. The class is designed to serve as a base for custom console commands in the OrangeHRM application.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: An abstract base class for all console commands in the OrangeHRM application, providing setup for styled input/output interactions and requiring subclasses to specify command names.

methods.name: getIO
methods.description: Returns the SymfonyStyle object used for styled console interactions.

methods.name: setIO
methods.description: Initializes the SymfonyStyle object with provided input and output interfaces.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Sets up the IO object before executing the parent run method to handle command execution.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to provide the command's name.
